admission.justification: The subprocess and injected lock cases exercise real serialization and both permitted exceptions, and distinguish ordinary acquisition errors.

applicability: Cold known-build cache lookups that share a directory.
conditions: The lock covers a second reuse check and the build when needed.
The cache directory and lock remain in place while in use.
Only the lock capability error and the 60-second acquisition timeout leave coordination process-local. Ordinary acquisition and builder errors reach the caller.
statement: One file lock per cache directory serializes cold builds, and only an ineffective lock or a 60-second acquisition timeout allows process-local coordination alone.
